topic.readerProblem: A buyer comparing AEOeye with AthenaHQ wants to know which of the two to use, what each costs now, and whether a one-off audit or a monitoring platform fits their situation.
topic.connection: AEOeye audits whether AI engines recommend a brand at one point in time; AthenaHQ monitors continuously. The page explains that difference honestly, says where AthenaHQ is stronger, and treats the audit as the first step before paying for monitoring.

assessment: The page is a documentation-based head-to-head: it discloses near the top that AthenaHQ facts come from its public pages as of October 2026 and that we have not tested it hands-on. It corrects the earlier version's outdated claims (no free tier, a discounted first month, a $0.08 overage price with 1,250-credit blocks, Enterprise from $2,000 a month, and a 'multi-engine' free AEOeye audit) against AthenaHQ's current plans page and AEOeye's actual product facts. It turns credits into a cost per response, sets that against SparkToro's run-to-run variance research, and says plainly where AthenaHQ wins. It deliberately does not claim hands-on use, quote AthenaHQ customer results, convert the 17% annual discount into a price, or assert what AthenaHQ's free audit button returns.

sources.supports: Free plan ($25 free credit, 300 credits, five platforms, unlimited members); Starter $295/month, 3,600 credits, 11 models, API access and extra credits as paid add-ons with no published price, CSV export; annual billing labeled 17% off; 1 credit = 1 AI response; Enterprise custom with SAML SSO, multi-region and BI dashboards; fetched with curl and WebFetch (plans URL is where athenahq.ai/pricing redirects).

Homepage: monitoring across 11+ models, on-page and off-page recommendations (AthenaHQ Content), integrations with GA4, Google Search Console, Shopify, Webflow and Framer, 'Get Free Audit (10m)' button.
Credit calculator estimates monthly credits across prompts, locations, models and cadence; 1 credit = 1 AI response.
Agency program: multi-brand client management with team permissions and Google Analytics integration, discounted licenses, GEO certification; no price stated.

600 volunteers, 12 prompts, 2,961 runs on ChatGPT, Claude and Google AI; under 1-in-100 chance of the same brand list twice for ChatGPT or Google AI; advice to ask 60-100 times and average (published 27 Jan 2026).
Definition of generative engine optimization as improving visibility in responses generated by generative AI systems.
